crossRefs.note: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will…

parallels.note: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

translations.web: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.
translations.bsb: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
translations.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
translations.asv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
